info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows for the modification of deposit lending parameters for corporate current accounts, identified by a unique parameter. Businesses can use this endpoint to adjust lending limits, terms, or conditions based on evolving financial strategies or customer requirements. Typical consumers include financial institutions and corporate treasury teams seeking to manage their lending portfolios effectively. The API supports an efficient and seamless update process, ensuring that financial data remains accurate and up-to-date.

patch.description: This operation allows for the updating of details for a specific Corporate Current Account identified by its account number. You can modify various attributes of the account as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary details for updating the corporate current account with the specified account number. Please ensure all required fields are accurately populated to successfully process the request.
